_comment: Edit this file to add/change node types, properties or styles. The extension reloads it automatically when it changes on disk.

text.description: Text content. In `slider`, a leading `@` treats it as a bundle key format string.

wrap.description: Whether text/content wraps. Also usable on `table` to create a WrapTable.

region.description: Atlas region name (falls back to an icon name if not found).

icon.description: Icon name from Icon.icons (used as a fallback drawable lookup too).

background.description: Atlas region/drawable used as this table's background.

margin.description: Margin applied to a table's or buttonTable's own body.

id.description: Assigns this element's name and registers it for lookup / result extraction.

hint.description: Placeholder/message text shown in an empty text field.

checked.description: Initial checked state (check box / toggleable button / buttonTable).

disabled.description: Initial disabled state. Only applies to elements implementing Disableable (button, imageButton, field, check, slider, buttonTable).

clicked.description: Result id fired via the result listener when clicked.

enter.description: Result id fired when Enter is pressed in a field.

style.description: Style name; must match the node's style class (see styles in schema).

group.description: Name of a shared ButtonGroup / CheckBox group.

condition.description: 'portrait', 'landscape', or e.g. 'width >= 400'. If false, node is skipped entirely.

color.description: Cell color tint (hex string or color name). Applies to any node's cell, regardless of type.

TextButtonStyle.name: defaultt
TextButtonStyle.description: Default text button style - gray corners at 45 degrees.

TextButtonStyle.name: logicTogglet
TextButtonStyle.description: Similar to flatToggle, but slightly tweaked for logic.

TextButtonStyle.name: flatToggleMenut
TextButtonStyle.description: Similar to flatToggle, but with a transparent base background.

TextButtonStyle.name: fullTogglet
TextButtonStyle.description: Similar to flatToggle, but without a darker border.

TextButtonStyle.name: logict
TextButtonStyle.description: Special square button for logic dialogs.

ImageButtonStyle.name: defaulti
ImageButtonStyle.description: Default image button style - gray corners at 45 degrees.

ImageButtonStyle.name: nodei
ImageButtonStyle.description: Used for research nodes in the tech tree.

ImageButtonStyle.name: emptyi
ImageButtonStyle.description: No background, tints the image itself when hovered.

ImageButtonStyle.name: selecti
ImageButtonStyle.description: Displays border around image when selected; used in placement fragment.

ImageButtonStyle.name: logici
ImageButtonStyle.description: Pure black version of emptyi, used for logic toolbar.

ImageButtonStyle.name: geni
ImageButtonStyle.description: Used for toolbar in map generation filters.

ImageButtonStyle.name: graySquarei
ImageButtonStyle.description: Gray square background, standard behavior. Equivalent to grayt.

ImageButtonStyle.name: clearNonei
ImageButtonStyle.description: No background unless focused, no border.

ScrollPaneStyle.name: noBarPane
ScrollPaneStyle.description: Scroll pane style with no visible scroll bar.

LabelStyle.name: outlineLabel
LabelStyle.description: Label style with an outline, used for text over art.

LabelStyle.name: techLabel
LabelStyle.description: Label style used in the tech tree.

TextFieldStyle.name: nodeField
TextFieldStyle.description: Text field style used for tech tree / node UIs.

TextFieldStyle.name: nodeArea
TextFieldStyle.description: Multi-line text area field style used for node UIs.
